_comment: Board -> SVD mapping + per-board metadata for Register Inspector. All board-specific knowledge lives here + in the SVD files, never hardcoded in C++. See docs/register_inspector_plan.md (Bolum 3.3, 4.3). Adding a new board = drop its .svd here + add a record below.

gdb.notes: ST-Link VCP (UART/COM port) durur SWD oturumu acikken (ST-Link FW V3J16M9); hedef cekirdek etkilenmez (DHCSR S_HALT=0, S_RETIRE_ST=1 boyunca dogrulandi) - bu ST-Link probe kaynagi paylasimi, cekirdek durmasi degil. UART, link kapanir kapanmaz aninda devam eder. Ayrica: gdbserver sureci duzgun kapandiktan (tasklist ile dogrulandi) sonra bile STM32_Programmer_CLI bir sureligine DEV_USB_COMM_ERR verebilir; fiziksel USB replug ile aninda duzelir - ST-Link firmware/surucu tuhafligi, kod tarafinda kaynak sizintisi degil.

boards.notes: Requires the board in DEVELOPMENT boot (BOOT jumper); in flash-boot the ROM's secure boot closes debug memory access and every read fails with 'Unable to get core ID'. In development boot, HOTPLUG attaches to the running core and live reads work - verified 2026-09-14. Device is in OPEN mode, Debug Authentication is not involved. Non-secure (0x46...) and secure (0x56...) peripheral aliases return identical values, so these SVD addresses are used as-is. See docs/n6_kaldigimiz_yer.md.

gdb.notes: ST-LINK_gdbserver CANNOT halt the N6 core, so no GDB session can be created: '-g' attach fails with 'Try halt... / Session manager. Fail starting session', '-k' with 'Target not halted after reset'. Also tried --halt, -m 0, --frequency, --pend-halt-timeout 30, -t, and both CubeProgrammer 2.23.0 and CubeIDE 2.2.0's bundled copy as -cp. Not a hardware limit: the same gdbserver attaches to H7 fine and STM32_Programmer_CLI halts this very N6 core fine. Use the CLI read backend on N6. Do not re-tune gdbserver options without new information.
